hunks.baseline: *Has it been more than thirty years?*
hunks.sol: *Has it been over thirty years?*

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong muttered to himself.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong mused to himself.

hunks.baseline: The stench of countless monsters and the smell of blood drifted in on the wind. It was the scent of a battlefield, one that stirred up nostalgia for the past.
hunks.sol: The stench of countless monsters and the reek of blood drifted in on the wind. It was the smell of a battlefield, stirring memories of long ago.

hunks.baseline: With a shrewd gaze that seemed at odds with his appearance, he watched the fog slowly draw nearer. The pale fog, where thousands of monsters were presumably lurking, radiated an ominous feeling simply by being there.
hunks.sol: With a shrewdness that belied his appearance, he watched the fog draw slowly nearer. Thousands of monsters lurked within that pale haze, which radiated an ominous air simply by existing.

hunks.baseline: Most of the troops were shaken, but to Lee Jungryong—a living witness to the Great Cataclysm—it was an entirely familiar sight.
hunks.sol: Most of the troops were shaken, but to Lee Jungryong—a living witness to the Great Cataclysm—it was an all-too-familiar sight.

hunks.baseline: At Lee Jungryong’s sudden question, Go Jun, the head of his security team standing one step behind him, answered.
hunks.sol: At Lee Jungryong’s sudden question, Go Jun, the Head of Security standing one step behind him, answered.

hunks.baseline: “That’s a good age. Looking back, I was the same. I had to survive one brush with death after another every day, but I had dreams back then.”
hunks.sol: “That’s a good age. Looking back, I was the same. Every day brought another brush with death, but I had dreams back then.”

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong gazed into the empty air with deep eyes.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong gazed into the distance.

hunks.baseline: It was as if his younger self were passing somewhere in the distance—a young man carrying the will to survive and the ambition to become the best.
hunks.sol: For a moment, he seemed to glimpse his younger self somewhere far away—a young man driven by the will to survive and the ambition to become the best.

hunks.baseline: But more than thirty years later, the man standing here was an old man nearing seventy.
hunks.sol: But more than thirty years later, the man standing here was nearing seventy.

hunks.baseline: “Sometimes, doubt creeps in. Doubt that everything I’ve built might come crashing down.”
hunks.sol: “Sometimes, doubt creeps in. I find myself wondering whether everything I’ve built might come crashing down.”

hunks.baseline: “Because you are here, Master.”
hunks.sol: —Because you are here, Master.

hunks.baseline: “What would you do if I fell?”
hunks.sol: —And what would you do if I fell?

hunks.baseline: “I can guarantee that will never happen.”
hunks.sol: —I can say with certainty that will never happen.

hunks.baseline: “There was a time when I thought of someone that way too. Someone stronger than anyone else, a wall I could never overcome even if I devoted my entire life to it.”
hunks.sol: —There was a time when I thought the same of someone else. He was stronger than anyone, an insurmountable wall I could never overcome even if I devoted my entire life to trying.

hunks.baseline: “He was the beginning and the end of the Great Cataclysm. He was everything. He was humanity’s savior, no different from a new god. But he, too, was nothing more than a human being.”
hunks.sol: —He was the beginning and end of the Great Cataclysm. He was everything. Humanity’s savior, no different from a new god. But even he was only human.

hunks.baseline: The hero who had accomplished immortal feats had not shown himself for a long time, and only a handful of people knew the secrets surrounding him.
hunks.sol: The hero who had achieved immortal feats had not shown himself for many years, and only a handful of people knew the secret surrounding him.

hunks.baseline: As one of those few, Lee Jungryong continued in a low voice.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong was one of them.

hunks.baseline: “Nothing is eternal, and nothing is certain. I’ve been thinking that a lot lately.”
hunks.sol: —Nothing is eternal, and nothing is certain. I’ve found myself thinking that more and more lately.

hunks.baseline: “……Is this because of Jin Taekyung?”
hunks.sol: —……Is this because of Jin Taekyung?

hunks.baseline: “When a crack begins, collapse comes in an instant. That bastard is the crack itself.”
hunks.sol: —Once a crack forms, collapse can come in an instant. That bastard is the crack itself.

hunks.baseline: “Then we must seal it before everything collapses.”
hunks.sol: —Then we must seal it before everything collapses.

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong watched the fog slide across the desolate plain. A gentle voice with a hidden blade flowed from between his lips.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong watched the fog slide across the desolate plain. When he spoke, his voice was gentle, but a blade lay hidden beneath it.

hunks.baseline: “I am at your command.”
hunks.sol: “I will obey.”

hunks.baseline: Hundreds, then thousands, of weapons were drawn at the same time behind him.
hunks.sol: Hundreds, then thousands, of weapons were drawn behind him at once.

hunks.baseline: They were the Ares Guild’s elites, forged through countless raids and training. The weapons held by them and by countless Chinese Hunters gleamed and rippled like waves.
hunks.sol: The Ares Guild’s elites, honed through countless raids and training exercises, stood alongside the Chinese Hunters. The light gleaming from their weapons rippled like waves.

hunks.baseline: Lee Jungryong slowly began to walk.
hunks.sol: Lee Jungryong began to walk.

hunks.baseline: There was no place here for soldiers or firearms. This was purely a battle between superhumans known as Hunters and monsters, and Lee Jungryong would reign as the god of the battlefield.
hunks.sol: There was no place here for soldiers or firearms. This was a battle solely between the superhumans known as Hunters and the monsters—and Lee Jungryong would reign as the god of the battlefield.

hunks.baseline: With that single word, Lee Jungryong shot forward like the wind. The fog filling the plain split apart on both sides along the path of his sword.
hunks.sol: With those two words, Lee Jungryong shot forward like the wind. His sword swept out, and the fog blanketing the plain split to either side along its path.

hunks.baseline: The young man drenched in green blood that reeked horribly barely managed to suppress his gagging.
hunks.sol: Drenched in horribly foul-smelling green blood, the young man barely managed to keep from gagging.
No, that was not quite right.

hunks.baseline: No—that was not quite right. More accurately, he had not even been given time to gag.
hunks.sol: It would be more accurate to say he was not even given the chance.

hunks.baseline: The upper section of his tower shield shattered, and a sharp fragment grazed the tip of his nose. Blood spurted out, and the scent of it pierced his nostrils.
hunks.sol: The upper edge of his tower shield shattered, and a sharp fragment grazed the tip of his nose. Blood sprayed out, and its metallic scent filled his nostrils.

hunks.baseline: The foul stench faded somewhat thanks to that, but an undead ogre that appeared to have died only recently was raising a massive iron club in front of him.
hunks.sol: It helped drown out the terrible stench, but directly before him, an undead ogre that looked freshly dead was raising a massive iron club.

hunks.baseline: The terrifying sound of something tearing through the air was enough to make the hair on his head stand on end.
hunks.sol: The terrifying sound of it tearing through the air was enough to make his hair stand on end.

hunks.baseline: The young man gritted his teeth and bent his legs. He used the mana-infused tower shield to protect his head.
hunks.sol: The young man gritted his teeth and bent his knees, shielding his head with his mana-infused tower shield.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous impact swept through his entire body. His head rang, and his arm hurt as if it had been broken.
hunks.sol: The tremendous impact tore through his entire body. His ears rang, his head reeled, and his arm hurt as though it had been broken.

hunks.baseline: But a broken arm was nowhere near important enough to count among his concerns.
hunks.sol: But a broken arm barely even counted as a problem right now.

hunks.baseline: Especially not when a five-meter-tall monster roaring ferociously was swinging an iron club as large as an adult man like a pinwheel.
hunks.sol: Not when a ferociously roaring, five-meter-tall monster was swinging an iron club as large as a grown man like a pinwheel.

hunks.baseline: Under the monster’s insane assault, the young man let out a scream edged with tears.
hunks.sol: Under the relentless assault, the young man screamed, his voice edging toward tears.

hunks.baseline: The young man was a veteran B-rank Hunter, and of course, he had fought ogres before.
hunks.sol: The young man was a veteran B-rank Hunter. Naturally, he had fought ogres before.

hunks.baseline: As befitted an A-rank monster, an ogre possessed tremendous strength and stamina, but they had never been this strong.
hunks.sol: As befitted A-rank monsters, ogres possessed tremendous strength and stamina, but they had never been this strong.

hunks.baseline: The young man stared blankly as the high-strength tower shield he had bought for a fortune at the beginning of the year was smashed to pieces in only five blows.
hunks.sol: The young man stared blankly as the high-strength tower shield he had bought for a fortune at the beginning of the year shattered after only five blows.

hunks.baseline: *What the hell… Did all of these things take drugs together?*
hunks.sol: *What the hell… Did all these things take drugs or something?*
They were far too strong.

hunks.baseline: They were far too strong. As he watched the iron club rise once more through the pale fog, the young man sensed his end.
hunks.sol: As he watched the iron club rise once more through the pale fog, the young man sensed that his end had come.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, a name flashed through his mind.
hunks.sol: At the same time, one name flashed through his mind.

hunks.baseline: If Jin Taekyung had simply pretended not to know him and walked past that day, he would never have gotten his shins kicked by some big shot or been drafted as a frontline tank.
hunks.sol: If Jin Taekyung had simply pretended not to know him and walked past that day, some big shot would never have kicked him in the shins, and he would not have been drafted as a frontline tank.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: And he would not be about to die like this.
hunks.sol: Then he would not be about to die like this.

hunks.baseline: He did not even dare think about dodging. He lacked the courage even to look straight at the iron club rushing toward him and filling his entire field of vision.
hunks.sol: Dodging was unthinkable. He did not even have the courage to look straight at the iron club hurtling toward him, filling his entire field of vision.

hunks.baseline: The young man squeezed his eyes shut and unconsciously let out a scream.
hunks.sol: The young man squeezed his eyes shut and let out an involuntary scream.

hunks.baseline: [^1]: *Bangzi* is a derogatory Chinese term for a Korean. Jin twists the insult into a threat to make the Hunter run bread for him, echoing Korean school slang for a bullied errand-runner.

hunks.baseline: And then, the next moment—
hunks.sol: And then, in the next instant—

hunks.baseline: His vision was dyed pitch-black. A cool breeze brushed across his entire body, and something poured down like a sudden shower.
hunks.sol: His vision went pitch-black. A cool breeze brushed across his entire body, and something poured down like a sudden shower.

hunks.baseline: Soon, a voice pierced his ears.
hunks.sol: Then a voice reached his ears.

hunks.baseline: “What kind of bastard?”
hunks.sol: “What did you just call me?”
The young man’s eyes flew open.

hunks.baseline: The young man’s eyes flew open. Green blood was scattering through the air in droplets. The enormous body of the undead ogre, now missing its head, was slowly toppling over.
hunks.sol: Green blood hung in droplets through the air. The enormous body of the undead ogre, now missing its head, was slowly toppling over.

hunks.baseline: And there was the face of a man scowling deeply.
hunks.sol: And before it stood a man with a deep scowl on his face.

hunks.baseline: He could not see it. He could not even follow it.
hunks.sol: He had not seen it. There had been no way he could.

hunks.baseline: The man reached out, and a streak of light that seemed to be a dagger pierced through three or four monsters. They collapsed like puppets with their strings cut.
hunks.sol: The man reached out, and a streak of light—probably a dagger—pierced three or four monsters. They crumpled like puppets with their strings cut.

hunks.baseline: “No, my ass. You fucking bastard.”
hunks.sol: “No, my ass, you fucking bastard.”

hunks.baseline: “You looked like you were in danger, so I saved you, and you call me a bangzi? You’d better survive. I’ll make you run bread for me until you die of old age.”
hunks.sol: “You looked like you were in danger, so I saved you, and you call me a bangzi? You’d better survive. I’m going to make you run bread for me until you die of old age.”

hunks.baseline: Every time the young man blinked, the monsters around him were falling like bundles of straw.
hunks.sol: Every time the young man blinked, the monsters around him fell like bundles of straw.

hunks.baseline: Blue flames erupted, and whenever the air split with a shriek, the space that had been packed so tightly there was nowhere to step was swept clean.
hunks.sol: Blue flames erupted, and whenever the air split with a shriek, an area that had been so densely packed there was nowhere to step was swept clean.

hunks.baseline: Everything began at a single man’s fingertips, and none of it looked like something a human being could have done.
hunks.sol: It all began at one man’s fingertips, and none of it looked like something a human being could have done.

hunks.baseline: The young man stared at him blankly and asked,
hunks.sol: The young man stared at him in a daze.

hunks.baseline: After a moment of silence, the man—Jin Taekyung—asked in return.
hunks.sol: After a moment of silence, Jin Taekyung asked in return,

hunks.baseline: *Graaaaaaak!*
hunks.sol: *Rrrrummmble!*

hunks.baseline: Blue flames swept across the earth. Steel melted, and monsters caught in the blaze screamed in agony.
hunks.sol: Blue flames swept across the earth. Steel melted, and monsters engulfed in the blaze screamed in agony.

hunks.baseline: After wiping out dozens of monsters with a single swing, Jin Taekyung glanced at the young man.
hunks.sol: After wiping out dozens of monsters with a single sweep, Jin Taekyung glanced at the young man.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, and this.”
hunks.sol: “Oh, and take this.”

hunks.baseline: Something flew toward the young man like a ray of light and struck him in the forehead, shattering.
hunks.sol: Something shot toward the young man like a ray of light, struck him in the forehead, and shattered.

hunks.baseline: Before he could react, the young man was drenched in translucent liquid, and a quiet voice reached his ears.
hunks.sol: Before he could react, translucent liquid drenched him, and Jin Taekyung’s low voice reached his ears.

hunks.baseline: “You’ll be fine now, so get back to fighting. Don’t go picking fights with ogres for no reason. Stick to the weaker ones. Got it?”
hunks.sol: “You’ll be fine now, so get back to fighting. Don’t go picking fights with ogres unless you want to get yourself killed. Stick to the weaker ones. Got it?”

hunks.baseline: The young man felt the wounds covering his entire body and his broken arm begin to heal. He nodded blankly.
hunks.sol: The young man felt the wounds covering his body close and his broken arm mend. He nodded blankly.

hunks.baseline: “Yes, yes.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. Yes.”

hunks.baseline: More than two hundred Hunters raced forward without hesitation along the path Jin Taekyung had opened, swinging their weapons.
hunks.sol: More than two hundred Hunters raced fearlessly along the path Jin Taekyung had opened, swinging their weapons as they went.

hunks.baseline: Two people at the very front stood out above all the rest.
hunks.sol: Two figures at the forefront stood out above all the rest.

hunks.baseline: “The formation has collapsed! Charge!”
hunks.sol: “Their formation has collapsed! Charge!”

hunks.baseline: A handsome man spouting incomprehensible Korean and a Hunter who looked especially young.
hunks.sol: One was a handsome man spouting incomprehensible Korean. The other was a remarkably young-looking Hunter.

hunks.baseline: The two moved like the wind, and their sword blades, wrapped in dazzling aura, cut the monsters apart.
hunks.sol: They moved like the wind, their blades wreathed in dazzling aura as they cut the monsters apart.

hunks.baseline: He had heard the story. Some of the S-rank Hunters, including Jin Taekyung, would lead the suicide squads on each front in a charge against the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: He had heard about them. A number of S-rank Hunters, including Jin Taekyung, would lead the suicide squads from each front in a charge against the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: As the young man gazed blankly at the scene, his chest suddenly grew hot. Some unknown strength surged up from within him, and he could not contain it.
hunks.sol: As the young man stared after them, his chest suddenly grew hot. An unknown strength surged up inside him, too powerful to contain.

hunks.baseline: The young man stared at his completely destroyed tower shield, then immediately turned and ran.
hunks.sol: The young man stared at his now completely shattered tower shield, turned on his heel, and ran.

hunks.baseline: *It’s over.*
hunks.sol: *That did it.*

hunks.baseline: The sensation traveling through the end of my fist was exactly right. With that certainty flashing through my mind, the head of the Lycanthrope snapping its teeth toward the back of my neck exploded.
hunks.sol: The impact against my knuckles told me all I needed to know. As certainty flashed through my mind, the head of the Lycanthrope lunging teeth-first for the back of my neck exploded.

hunks.baseline: A Lycanthrope at level 90-something?
hunks.sol: A Lycanthrope at level ninety-something?

hunks.baseline: I already knew that Level was not an absolute measure, but the monsters gathered on this battlefield were definitely different from the ones I had seen in Gates.
hunks.sol: I already knew Level was not an absolute measure, but the monsters gathered on this battlefield were clearly different from the ones I had encountered in Gates.

hunks.baseline: Their Levels were somewhat higher, and their Agility and strength were superior too.
hunks.sol: Their Levels were slightly higher, and they were superior in Agility and raw strength as well.

hunks.baseline: If it had been one or two monsters, I might have brushed it off. But everything from F-rank goblins to A-rank monsters was like this. You would have to be an idiot not to find it strange.
hunks.sol: If it had been one or two monsters, I might have brushed it off. But everything from F-rank goblins to A-rank monsters was like this. You would have to be an idiot not to realize something was wrong.

hunks.baseline: I turned at the urgent voices coming from behind me and saw monsters filling the path I had opened without leaving a single gap.
hunks.sol: I turned at the urgent shouts behind me and saw monsters packing the path I had opened, leaving no gaps between them.

hunks.baseline: The suicide squad was fighting desperately against them.
hunks.sol: The suicide squad was fighting desperately to hold them back.

hunks.baseline: “Get the hell out of here—all of you.”
hunks.sol: “Get the hell out of here. All of you.”

hunks.baseline: For the monsters, I was an existence they could neither block nor evade.
hunks.sol: To the monsters, I was something they could neither stop nor evade.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of fist shadows shot out like cannonballs and rained down over their heads.
hunks.sol: Dozens of fist shadows shot out like cannonballs and rained down upon their heads.

hunks.baseline: Some were sent flying into the distance as bloody pulp. Others simply collapsed where they stood.
hunks.sol: Some were reduced to bloody pulp and hurled into the distance. Others simply crumpled where they stood.

hunks.baseline: I charged into the space that had momentarily been emptied.
hunks.sol: I charged into the space that had opened.

hunks.baseline: A spearhead imbued with Force cut through bone and flesh, hacking in every direction. As the monsters fell, System notifications rang out without pause.
hunks.sol: A spearhead wreathed in Force tore through bone and flesh, carving through everything around me. As the monsters fell, System notifications rang out without pause.

hunks.baseline: Then came the cheerful chime I had not heard in a long time.
hunks.sol: Then came a cheerful chime I had not heard in a long time.
I could feel it.

hunks.baseline: I could feel it. The internal energy that had been slowly draining away was filling to the brim, and the fatigue accumulated in my body was vanishing as if it had been washed away.
hunks.sol: My steadily draining internal energy filled to the brim, and the fatigue accumulated throughout my body vanished as if it had been washed away.

hunks.baseline: “Give us your orders!”
hunks.sol: “What is it?”

hunks.baseline: I shouted in a voice loud enough to shake the entire battlefield.
hunks.sol: I shouted loudly enough for my voice to shake the entire battlefield.

hunks.baseline: “Fog! Get as far outside the fog’s range as possible!”
hunks.sol: “The fog! Get as far outside its range as you can!”

hunks.baseline: This was not merely unpleasant, damp fog. It was a kind of magic wielded by the Arch Lich.
hunks.sol: This was not merely unpleasant, clammy fog. It was a kind of Magic wielded by the Arch Lich.

hunks.baseline: Magic that strengthened the monsters within its range—or rather, made them *Darkened*.
hunks.sol: It strengthened the monsters within its range—or rather, made them *Darkened*.

hunks.baseline: *Damn magic.*
hunks.sol: *Damn Magic.*

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, as I glared at the mysterious fog filling the area around me—
hunks.sol: Just as I glared at the mysterious fog surrounding us—

hunks.baseline: A thunderous roar that made it seem as if the sky had split apart echoed across heaven and earth.
hunks.sol: A thunderous roar, as if the sky itself had split apart, echoed across heaven and earth.
[^1]: *Bangzi* is a derogatory Chinese term for a Korean. Jin turns the insult into a threat to make the Hunter run bread for him, echoing Korean school slang for a bullied errand-runner.
